dedupe_keys.name: nwashc liberia water point and wash mapping datasets 2011 2016 2017

description: The National Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Commission of Liberia gives direct access to the raw data of the national WASH mappings. The datasets page lists the 2017 WASH inventory of all 20,205 water points with WASH data, collected from April to July 2017; a 2016 WASH in Schools assessment of 5,375 rows collected from December 2015 to January 2016; and the 2011 mapping of 10,188 improved water points, with a cleaned file of all water points with geographic attributes. Each is an XLSX file under the Open Database License, with the Ministry of Public Works as source. An interactive map shows water point functionality, management types and types of water point at schools. Coverage is all of Liberia. Access is free by direct download. Caveats: the latest survey is from 2017, and the data are unprocessed as the page states. Simulation uses: point inventory of rural water supply assets with their functionality for service coverage and outage studies. Related records: national water point inventories on HDX (data-hdx-national-water-point-inventories) and the SIASAR rural water information system (data-siasar-rural-water-sanitation-information-system).
